estimand.population: Mexico analytical-use design: adults aged 25-79 with no reported prior doctor diagnosis of diabetes/high blood sugar, recorded 8-12-hour fast, positive fasting serum glucose below 126 mg/dL, available HbA1c and valid standing anthropometry with internally consistent measurement documentation (uniformly excluding explicit not-weighed or alternative-standing-route documentation that contradicts usable standing measurements, without asserting which field is correct) under the prespecified measurement restrictions; pregnancy/lactation excluded when documented by questionnaire routing for women aged 25-49; no verified medication or anemia exclusion. Exactly 375 fictional individuals per female=0/1 crossed with age bands 25-39, 40-54, 55-69, 70-79; equal-stratum analytical design, not a nationally representative population.
